# Position-sensitive namespace aliases

```tsx
import * as RootApi from 'annota';
import * as ToolApi from 'annota/tools';

let Alias = RootApi;
Alias.PointTool;
Alias = { PointTool: class LocalPointTool {} };
new Alias.PointTool();
Alias = RootApi;
Alias.PointTool;

let FirstAlias = RootApi;
let SecondAlias = FirstAlias;
FirstAlias = { PointTool: class FirstLocalPointTool {} };
new FirstAlias.PointTool();
new SecondAlias.PointTool();
SecondAlias = { PointTool: class SecondLocalPointTool {} };
new SecondAlias.PointTool();

let CanonicalAlias = ToolApi;
new CanonicalAlias.PointTool();
CanonicalAlias = RootApi;
new CanonicalAlias.PointTool();
CanonicalAlias = ToolApi;
new CanonicalAlias.PointTool();

let BranchAlias = RootApi;
if (shouldReplace) {
  new BranchAlias.PointTool();
  BranchAlias = { PointTool: class BranchLocalPointTool {} };
  new BranchAlias.PointTool();
}
new BranchAlias.PointTool();

let LoopAlias = RootApi;
while (shouldContinue) {
  new LoopAlias.PointTool();
  LoopAlias = { PointTool: class LoopLocalPointTool {} };
  new LoopAlias.PointTool();
}
new LoopAlias.PointTool();
```
